registry_notice: Governed definitions for the deterministic synthetic nAIM core KPI surface. Movement guardrails are operational triage rules, not statistical significance or causal evidence.

metrics.name: Active accounts
metrics.business_definition: Accounts open, non-charged-off and eligible for activity at period end.
metrics.formula: count(account-month rows where inactive_flag = 0 and chargeoff_flag = 0)
metrics.caveats: Synthetic demonstration population; the validated source grain is one account-month row.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The count of eligible active accounts in the selected governed scope and month.
cannot_conclude: Growth quality, customer intent, or the causal effect of a strategy.
caveats: A larger count is favourable only as an operating convention; mix and risk outcomes must also be reviewed.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect openings, attrition, risk mix, and data-quality evidence before changing strategy.

guardrail_rule.denominator_rule: current eligible active account count; minimum 1
guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Account growth
metrics.business_definition: Ending active accounts divided by beginning active accounts minus one.
metrics.exclusions: Recovery-only and inactive rows from each period's active population
metrics.caveats: Gross openings and attrition are not separately identified by this net movement.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: Net month-over-month movement in the governed active-account population.
cannot_conclude: Whether acquisition or retention caused the movement, or whether growth is profitable.
caveats: The comparison uses the immediately prior available month.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Decompose openings and attrition by governed segment before an operating decision.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Ending receivables
metrics.business_definition: Sum of ending account balances in the reporting month.
metrics.caveats: Synthetic USD; balances are additive within a month but not across months.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The synthetic USD balance held in the selected scope at month end.
cannot_conclude: Credit quality, future collections, or the causal source of balance growth.
caveats: Higher balances are favourable only as a planning convention and may raise risk exposure.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Review utilization, delinquency, loss, and segment mix before changing exposure.

adequacy_rule.denominator_rule: current eligible active account count supplied with the KPI

guardrail_rule.denominator_rule: current eligible active account count; minimum 1
guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Transaction value
metrics.business_definition: Eligible synthetic transaction value in the reporting month.
metrics.aggregation_behaviour: additive within and across non-overlapping periods
metrics.caveats: Synthetic USD transaction value; active-transacting accounts are used only for adequacy context.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The aggregate validated transaction value in the selected scope and month.
cannot_conclude: Transaction profitability, authorization quality, or causal demand drivers.
caveats: Value should be reviewed with transaction count, fraud, and friction.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect value and count mix by governed dimension before changing controls.

adequacy_rule.denominator_rule: active accounts with transaction_count greater than zero

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Portfolio utilization
metrics.business_definition: Portfolio ending balance divided by portfolio credit limit.
metrics.caveats: Never average account-level utilization; the denominator is positive limits, not account count.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The ratio of aggregate ending balances to aggregate positive limits in scope.
cannot_conclude: Individual borrower stress, optimal line assignment, or causal strategy impact.
caveats: Higher utilization is treated as favourable commercially but must be reviewed with delinquency and loss.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect risk-band and vintage mix before a line-management decision.

guardrail_rule.denominator_rule: aggregate positive credit limit; minimum governed value 30
guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: 30+ delinquency rate
metrics.business_definition: Eligible active accounts at least 30 days past due divided by active eligible accounts.
metrics.formula: count(account-month rows where days_past_due >= 30 and active) / active_accounts
metrics.caveats: Account-weighted; a balance-weighted view is a separate metric.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The descriptive share of active accounts at least 30 days past due in scope.
cannot_conclude: Default probability, lifetime loss, or the causal effect of acquisition or collections policy.
caveats: Month-end delinquency status does not describe within-month cures or roll paths.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect roll rates, vintage maturity, and segment mix before changing credit strategy.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Annualised net loss rate
metrics.business_definition: Monthly net credit loss divided by average receivables, multiplied by twelve.
metrics.exclusions: Undefined when aggregate average daily balance is zero
metrics.caveats: Annualised for comparability; it is not a forecast or lifetime-loss estimate.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The annualised descriptive ratio of observed monthly net loss to average balance.
cannot_conclude: Future loss, expected credit loss, regulatory capital, or causation.
caveats: One month is multiplied by twelve and may be seasonal or volatile.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Reconcile charge-offs and recoveries, then inspect roll rates and vintage-aligned drivers.

guardrail_rule.denominator_rule: aggregate average daily balance; minimum governed value 100
guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Confirmed fraud rate
metrics.business_definition: Confirmed fraud loss divided by eligible transaction value, expressed in basis points.
metrics.caveats: Confirmed loss only; alert incidence and false-positive rate are separate.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: Confirmed fraud loss per ten thousand units of validated transaction value.
cannot_conclude: Attempted fraud, model precision, unconfirmed exposure, or causal control effectiveness.
caveats: Confirmation lag is not modelled as inferential uncertainty.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect confirmed-loss concentration and alert outcomes before changing fraud controls.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Fraud-alert transaction rate
metrics.business_definition: Fraud alerts divided by eligible transaction decisions.
metrics.caveats: Alert incidence is not confirmed fraud and does not measure precision.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The descriptive share of eligible transaction decisions that generated a fraud alert.
cannot_conclude: Fraud prevalence, detection recall, or whether an alert was correct.
caveats: Lower alert incidence is favourable only when fraud loss and missed fraud do not worsen.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Review confirmed fraud, false positives, and segment mix before threshold changes.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Manual-review rate
metrics.business_definition: Manual reviews divided by eligible transaction decisions.
metrics.caveats: Transaction count is the deterministic eligible-decision proxy.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The descriptive share of eligible decisions routed to manual review.
cannot_conclude: Review productivity, review correctness, or causal control performance.
caveats: A lower review rate is not favourable if confirmed fraud or false negatives worsen.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Review capacity, outcome yield, fraud loss, and customer friction before routing changes.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: False-positive rate
metrics.business_definition: Flagged legitimate events divided by all fraud alerts recorded in the reporting month.
metrics.caveats: The deterministic source does not expose a separate resolved-alert denominator; all recorded alerts are used.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The descriptive share of recorded alerts labelled false positive in the synthetic source.
cannot_conclude: Production model precision, unresolved-case outcomes, recall, or causal threshold impact.
caveats: All recorded alerts are the implemented denominator; do not relabel it as resolved alerts.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect outcome completeness and alert segments before model or threshold changes.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Customer-friction rate
metrics.business_definition: Distinct accounts with a review, decline, step-up, or contact event and no confirmed fraud event divided by active transacting accounts.
metrics.formula: count_distinct(account_id with friction event and confirmed_fraud_event_count = 0) / active_transacting_accounts
metrics.numerator: distinct accounts with a qualifying friction event and no confirmed fraud event
metrics.exclusions: Rows with confirmed fraudulent activity are not labelled avoidable friction
metrics.caveats: A synthetic event-composition proxy, not a survey or causal experience measure; the implemented numerator is not additionally restricted to active transacting accounts.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The implemented ratio of distinct accounts with qualifying friction events and no confirmed fraud event to active transacting accounts.
cannot_conclude: Customer sentiment, avoidability for an individual event, or causal effect on attrition.
caveats: Multiple events on one account count once; the numerator is not additionally restricted by active or transacting status.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect event composition, account status, confirmed-fraud exclusions, and affected segments before control changes.

adequacy_rule.denominator_rule: distinct active accounts with transaction_count greater than zero

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Complaint rate
metrics.business_definition: Recorded complaints per one thousand active accounts.
metrics.exclusions: Inactive and charged-off rows from the active-account denominator
metrics.caveats: Synthetic recorded complaints; complaint severity and substantiation are not encoded.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: Recorded complaint events per one thousand active accounts in scope.
cannot_conclude: Complaint severity, root cause, substantiation, or causal customer harm.
caveats: Multiple complaints can arise from one account; the numerator is events, not distinct accounts.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Review complaint taxonomy and segment concentration before remediation prioritisation.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Attrition rate
metrics.business_definition: Current-period attrition flags divided by prior-period active accounts.
metrics.exclusions: Charge-off status is not a separate numerator component
metrics.caveats: Voluntary and risk-driven closure reasons are not separated by this aggregate.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

can_conclude: The descriptive current-period attrition flags relative to prior active accounts.
cannot_conclude: Customer intent, closure reason, lifetime retention, or causal impact of policy.
caveats: The implemented denominator is the immediately prior available active population.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Inspect closure reasons, friction, and risk segment mix before a retention action.

guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.

metrics.name: Expected portfolio profit
metrics.business_definition: Transparent synthetic revenue less funding, operating, credit, fraud, review, and friction costs.
metrics.formula: average_daily_balance * revenue_rate + transaction_value * transaction_revenue_rate - funding_cost - operating_cost - net_credit_loss - confirmed_fraud_loss - manual_review_cost - customer_friction_cost
metrics.aggregation_behaviour: additive across non-overlapping periods under fixed assumptions
metrics.caveats: A deterministic planning output using synthetic editable assumptions; not accounting profit or a forecast.
metrics.source_grain: one validated row per account_id and calendar month

supporting_sources.join_rule: left many-to-one on account_id when governed filter dimensions are requested

supporting_sources.source_grain: one governed Baseline assumption set for assumption_version 1.0.0
supporting_sources.join_rule: selected by exact scenario name Baseline; no relational join

can_conclude: The configured Baseline planning contribution for the selected validated synthetic scope and month.
cannot_conclude: Realised accounting profit, forecast accuracy, causal strategy lift, or regulatory profitability.
caveats: All economic inputs are synthetic editable assumptions and must be version-checked.
interpretation_boundary.permitted_next_action: Review component contributions and assumption sensitivity before approving a strategy.

adequacy_rule.denominator_rule: current eligible active account count supplied with the KPI

guardrail_rule.denominator_rule: current eligible active account count; minimum 1
guardrail_rule.explanation_template: {metric_name} is {status}: observed month-over-month change {observed_change}, applied threshold {threshold} {unit}.
